settings.heading: Built by Collectors, for Collectors.
settings.intro: We specialize in authentic singles, factory-sealed booster boxes, and precision-graded collector slabs across Pokémon, Yu-Gi-Oh!, Magic: The Gathering, Disney Lorcana, and more.

settings.title: Strict Grading & Condition Checks
settings.text: Every single card is inspected under studio lighting for surface, centering, corners, and edges before entering our climate-controlled vault.

settings.title: Factory-Sealed Provenance
settings.text: Our booster boxes, Elite Trainer Boxes, and collector gift sets come directly from authorized distribution channels with intact factory wrap.

settings.title: Collector-Grade Packaging
settings.text: Singles ship in a penny sleeve, rigid toploader, team bag, and bubble mailer. Graded slabs and sealed boxes ship double-boxed with corner protection.
